notes.title: Playtest Ending Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the players who participated in the demo version playtest. We will be ending the current demo version playtest on October 14, 2024, at 19:00 (UTC+8).

If you enjoyed our game, you can add it to your wishlist, and we also hope that everyone can continue to provide us with feedback and suggestions!

We will fix bugs and optimize based on player feedback and suggestions, and then reopen the demo version. The specific time for the next opening will be announced.

Thank you all!
"Legends of Aden" Development Team

notes.title: "Legends of Aden" Demo Version Test Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Warriors,
We are excited to announce that the "Legends of Aden" Demo version is about to launch a 7-day wipe test event! This is a fantastic opportunity to explore a mysterious continent and experience an epic adventure. We cordially invite you to join us in this adventure to test the game's stability and balance.
As this test is a wipe and non-payment test, the in-app purchase channel will not be available during this test.

Test Schedule: 
Start Time: October 8, 2024, at 10:30 (UTC+8) 
End Time: October 15, 2024, at 10:30 (UTC+8)

Test Rules: 
This test is a wipe test, and all data will be cleared after the test ends. 
This test skips the initial main quest guide and level-up process, starting the game experience from level 40, and will provide a set of hero-quality weapons, equipment, and accessories for your profession, as well as rare quality exclusive transformations and summoning spirits.
During the test period, the game will start at 9:00 AM (UTC+8) each day and distribute free mail benefits every three hours, including free diamonds, gold coins, card draw vouchers, and various other items.

How to Receive Benefits: 
Enter the game and create a character, the benefits will be automatically sent to your in-game mailbox at the specified time.
Note that the email validity period is 24 hours, so please claim your rewards in time.

Notes:
Please ensure a stable network environment for the best gaming experience. 
During the test period, if you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please feel free to provide feedback through the game community. 
Your feedback is crucial to us, and we express our heartfelt thanks and respect.

We look forward to your participation in creating our legend together! For more details and updates, please follow our community center.
"Legends of Aden" Development Team
